$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=3{e}^{3x}\,⟹\,\frac{2}{3}\text{d}u=2{e}^{3x}\,\text{d}x.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\int 2{e}^{3x}{({e}^{3x}+1)}^{3}\,\text{d}x & =\int {({e}^{3x}+1)}^{3}\cdot 2{e}^{3x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\int {u}^{3}\,\frac{2}{3}\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{2}{3}\int {u}^{3}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{2}{3}\frac{{u}^{4}}{4}+C \\  & =\frac{{({e}^{3x}+1)}^{4}}{6}+C.\end{aligned}
$$
